title: Street / Oversized wordmarks
slide_intent: Test an identity at architectural scale because a familiar signature must still hold together when cropped by its surroundings.
strategic_value: Large contrasting signatures can give Twitch a visible street presence with little supporting text.
demonstration: Two oversized Twitch wordmarks occupy adjacent pale and black wall panels; colored depth extends beneath both.
practical_value: Compare legibility and contrast when the signature becomes the dominant environmental element.

content_islands.name: Two wall panels
content_islands.spec: Place large signatures on adjacent pale and black fields with differing gradients below.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain the parked car, pavement and building edges to establish viewing scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork presents the signature at large scale on a street-facing wall.
